datasets.name: collate_feed_health
queryLines:
SELECT f.*,
 CASE WHEN feed_outcome='Collate assignment source not configured' THEN 'Source not configured'
 WHEN latest_feed_observation IS NULL THEN 'No observation in feed'
 WHEN latest_feed_observation>current_timestamp()+INTERVAL 5 MINUTES THEN 'Observation timestamp is in the future'
 WHEN timestampdiff(SECOND,latest_feed_observation,current_timestamp())>freshness_target_days*86400
 THEN 'Refresh overdue' ELSE 'Within review threshold' END AS feed_freshness_state,
 round(timestampdiff(SECOND,latest_feed_observation,current_timestamp())/86400.0,1) AS feed_age_days
FROM `ifbi_edw_dev_raw`.`governance_observability`.`raw_classification_collate_feed_health` f

lines:
## Raw Classification Intelligence
Current classification coverage, mapped-source agreement and stewardship actions across the configured Raw catalogs. This edition reads the deployed inventory views; scheduled change monitoring and notifications have not been configured in this step.

frame.title: Coverage and action concentration by schema

lines: **Interpretation:** coverage measures tag presence; recognized values follow the configured taxonomy. Agreement uses only columns with a valid assigned tier and a usable mapped requirement. Blank agreement means there are no comparable columns. A tagging gap does not by itself establish PII exposure or masking behavior.

## Find the remediation owner and the largest gaps
Counts include each visible column once, including columns without tags. Integration metadata is kept visible so scope choices remain explicit.

## Trace every column to its evidence
Use the global schema, table, sensitivity and outcome filters. Name hints are metadata review aids; they are not content-scanning results or automatic classifications.

## Compare assigned tiers with mapped source requirements
Exact source-tag names and values are matched to classification_mapping. Multiple valid requirements resolve to the strongest tier (priority 1 first). Unmapped labels and inconsistent rules remain visible alongside agreement.

fields.name: metric
fields.expression: COALESCE(COUNT_IF(`expected_priority` IS NOT NULL AND `sensitivity_state`='Missing sensitivity tag'),0)

## Collate reconciliation with explicit source outcomes
This feed contains glossary assignments. Only current, confirmed, non-deleted column assignments from the configured source service, matched to a visible Raw column and a consistent sensitivity mapping, contribute a requirement. Business glossary terms are not automatically sensitivity classes.

frame.title: Raw assignment trace — empty when the feed has no Raw candidates

lines: **Reading this page:** source-feed and reference totals do not follow the column filters. Raw candidate, identity and mapped-assignment cards total the configured Raw catalog scopes. The largest-source-feed card uses a maximum because multiple catalogs may share one feed. Freshness is calculated from the source observation timestamp against the configured review threshold, not from dashboard refresh time. Zero Raw candidates means this inspected glossary feed supplies no Raw reconciliation candidates; it does not establish what exists elsewhere in Collate.

fields.name: metric
fields.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `feed_freshness_state`='Refresh overdue' THEN `source_table` END)

Validate the mapping rows themselves, find unmapped source labels and inspect the actual tag vocabulary. Rules use exact keys and values; no automatic alias from auto_class to General or another classification key is assumed.

## Prioritized stewardship
The detailed queue shows P1/P2 configuration corrections and evidence reviews. Ordinary missing-tag backlog stays aggregated by schema/table on the coverage pages. Queue rows are review findings, not automatically created incidents or sent notifications.

lines:
## Deployment scope and metric definitions
The same dashboard is bound to each environment’s governance catalog/schema at deployment. Included catalogs, schema exclusions, reference sources, source service identity and review thresholds come from that environment’s configuration. Inventory visibility follows the execution identity and source-view permissions.

### Definitions
**Tag coverage:** columns with a sensitivity-tag assignment / visible columns.
**Recognized tier:** one sensitivity value recognized by the configured taxonomy; this does not prove the tag is governed.
**Mapped agreement:** equal assigned and expected priorities / columns with both a recognized tier and usable mapped evidence. No comparables produces a blank percentage.
**Mapping consistency:** classification, short class and numeric priority agree with the configured taxonomy; conflicting source-key targets require correction.
**Collate reconciliation:** exact column identity and explicitly mapped terms, with confirmation, deletion and freshness checks. A business glossary assignment is not automatically a sensitivity classification.
**Name hints:** column-name patterns for steward review; they can miss PII or flag non-PII.
**Story 1 scope:** classification metadata and stewardship. Policy definitions, masking behavior, identity-based enforcement tests and ML are separate work.

### Sources and refresh
Unity Catalog columns, tables and column tags; configured classification mappings and optional Collate glossary assignments. All counts are calculated when datasets refresh. Dataset query time and the last source-feed observation are separate fields. This edition has no historical journal, scheduled monitor, notification delivery or enforcement-test results. Operational change monitoring follows dashboard validation in DEV.
